results.title: SIMPLER Hair Color is rated "Average" with 3.5 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
## Review summary

Created with AI, based on recent reviews

Considering 160 reviews, most reviewers were somewhat happy with their experience overall. Consumers consistently find the products very easy to apply at home and genuinely appreciate the natural color finish without leaving messy skin stains behind. Many people frequently mention the incredible convenience of the application process and the reliable, long-lasting color results achieved. However, some customers also noted frustrating mechanical issues with the dispenser, where occasionally only the developer comes out instead of the proper color mixture. Additionally, a few people felt the item is quite expensive for what it offers and reported experiencing unexpected skin irritation or allergic reactions.See more [...] For context, I colored my hair on September 3. By September 14, my hair was already mostly brown again when it should have remained black.  
  
UPDATE: Simpler responded to my review by saying that nothing has changed and that the product is still the same.  
  
That response is actually more concerning to me than the original problem.  
  
Look through your recent reviews. There are longtime customers saying the same thing: the product does not perform the way they remember it performing. Customers are reporting issues with product consistency, defective bottles, poor coverage, fading, and even missing items. [...] 6 days ago

Image 36: Rated 1 out of 5 stars

## I purchased the Simpler Hair Color for beard dye
I purchased the Simpler Hair Color for Beards directly from their website. When the product arrived, the product canister was empty of brown dye. For over 3 weeks I have emailed Simpler at their hello customer service email address multiple times with no response. Nothing. Crickets.  
When they sent me 2 recent marketing emails I again responded to those with my product problem issue. Again no response. I've had it. They obviously have so many product complaints, they don't have the resources and will to solve them. So the customer gets screwed by their fraudulent business practices and lack of product quality control. Sad.

results.title: Use This Simple Model to Resolve Common Customer Service Complaints
results.content: There is, however, a fine line between efficiently routing calls and delivering a frustrating customer experience. If a customer complains about getting stuck in an endless electronic or even live help loop, your representatives should be prepared to listen, acknowledge, and resolve this very real problem. Representatives should be trained in understanding the phone systems so they can provide guidance on how customers can more efficiently get the help they need. This training may involve role playing, in which one trainee assumes the part of the customer. Without a simple model in place, many service representatives apologize for the poor experience, but move on too quickly from this complaint without acknowledging or taking the next steps toward a complete resolution. [...] Rather than simply mirroring a customer’s dissatisfaction with a prior representative’s lack of knowledge, put our model into place. Listen carefully to the customer’s tone and try to empathize with the level of frustration and the problems that a lack of knowledge may have caused the customer. In acknowledging the problem, explain how your business values employee training, and has a rigorous process. Let the customer know that several employees have been going through the instruction sequence and are close to reaching proficiency.
